finalProse.chartStory: GEV is only starting to pull back toward the 20-day average. Buyers have not shown enough yet, so the setup is still early.
finalProse.whyItMatters: This matters because early pullbacks can become good setups later, but support still needs to prove itself.
finalProse.setupLocation: Price is easing back toward support inside a constructive trend, but the test is still developing.
finalProse.learningPoint: A chart can be constructive and still too early at the same time. Traders care about both location and timing.
finalProse.whatNext: Watch for a cleaner support test and proof that buyers are stepping in before expecting the setup to improve.
